questions.question: Who were the parents of María Josefa García Romero (born about 1843, Vélez-Málaga, Málaga, Spain)?
questions.rationale: Primary research objective. She carries two surnames and no parent is in the tree; nothing has been searched yet.

quirks: Civil registration in Spain began in 1871; for a birth about 1843 the parish baptism register is the primary record.
The Santa María parish registers for Vélez-Málaga from 1837 (image groups 004104131) are not name-indexed but are full-text searchable; a 1841-1845 births volume (004458370) is 96% name-indexed.
Baptism entries in this period normally name both parents and the four grandparents.

## Vélez-Málaga, Málaga, Spain — 1835-1870

Before civil registration (1871) the parish books are the vital record. Santa María's books from 1837 are on FamilySearch, unindexed but full-text searchable; one births volume for 1841-1845 is name-indexed.
